export function spinAround(camera: ArcRotateCamera, scene: SceneContext, turns: number): Promise<void> {

        chunks.push(chunk);

        const goal = { alpha: currentAlpha };
        promise = promise.then(() => interpolateArcRotateCamera(camera, scene, goal));
    }
    
    return promise;
}
